title: dryopteris subgranulosa
intro: Dryopteris subgranulosa, commonly known as the Subgranulate Wood fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a perennial plant native to tropical and subtropical regions, valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits. The Subgranulate Wood fern is used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal value.
